name: Armillary
author: E. T. Carter
description: Four dark steel rings nested in a gimbal round a small burning core, on a post on a dark studio floor. Each ring pivots inside the one outside it at its own slow pace, so they fall into line and out again and never repeat, each with a line of light round its inside in a theme colour. One spot from the upper left throws the shadow of the rings across the floor.

sculpture.label: Four rings nested in a gimbal round a burning core, each pivoting inside the last at its own pace, so they fall into line and out again and never repeat.

params.label: Turn
